scope: Independent read-only cross-review of final model and padding English statements, proof outlines, resource/quantifier contracts, and program roles against actual Lean source. No manuscript or mathematical proof edits by reviewer.

checks.label: def:target
checks.exact_statement: One deterministic native finite machine and one natural constant c; for every positive d, raw row-major transpose with b(d)=max(1,ceil log2 d), output encoding unchanged, time c(P+1). Matches entryBits, TransposesWithin, LinearTimeTransposable and ComputesWithin.
checks.outline: Definition only; no proof outline required. Machine initial tapes/heads/output, input end-marker behavior and transition output rate agree with Statement.lean.
checks.program_role: Defines the same fixed-machine target for both programs; no weakening to nonuniform or coded-output transposition.

checks.label: thm:padding
checks.exact_statement: Outer absolute natural A,H,K0,E precede every M; the same Mprime precedes all positive dimensions, canonical-length words, outputs and time bounds. Exact state equality H+(q+1), tape equality K0+(k+E)*max(1,g.size), and cellBits=3 match exists_uniform_paid_padding. Part (a) has actual halting at T<=A*P+t with exact same output and full-run zero-slack CutIneq. Part (b) restricts to positive d_i tending to infinity, one fixed natural a and all payload computations within a*P_i; the same Mprime gives actual times with coefficient A+a and NativeRunLimits.Conclusion.
checks.outline: Analytic unconditional existence feeds continuous_uniform_computation_with_cut, whose all-size expansion gives fixed stretch and extra-tape constants. PaidPayload.execute_with_blank_prefix and preserves_computation supply blank handoff and additive paid time. BitPlaneRun.stepN_embed gives exact one-step payload simulation. cut_after_prefix uses full-horizon paths/head count; NativeRunLimits.of_cut gives the complete limiting assertion. No extra simulation or asymptotic claim is inserted.
checks.program_role: Explicitly supplies motion with paid generation/execution/cleanup to construction; shows the original cut and full M* conditions alone can be attached to any candidate linear transposer, so impossibility needs further information. Does not assert a transpose code or defeat every geometric lower-bound method.

checks.label: lem:rational-expander
checks.exact_statement: The endpoint quantifies over Fin(c+1), eps>0, maps into Icc(0,1), and every measurable S subset Icc with real Lebesgue measure <=1/2. RationalMobius gives nonempty rational interval endpoints, rational coefficients, positive determinant and positive endpoint denominators; bounded uses the open interval and strictMonoOn_eval gives increase. The stated image-union inequality matches exactly.
checks.outline: exists_rational_restricted_gap supplies a rational free family near identity and a grid K; RestrictedL2Gap implies RestrictedCorrelationGap. expansion_of_restrictedCorrelationGap uses a trimmed, cell-centered normalized indicator and lower correlations for each generator and inverse, contradicting the symmetric gap. Clipped augmented family yields open domains and removes endpoints without changing the measured expansion.
checks.program_role: Discharges the analytic premise of the native wrapper. Existing continuous-expander strategy/existence is attributed to Bourgain–Yehudayoff; no independent novelty claim is made for that analytic existence.

checks.label: padding-discrete-and-limit-contracts
checks.exact_statement: pairRes is the union of resident pairs over every pre-T step of a slot; prevBlock uses the most recent block change. IsChord demands x+1<z and absence from all intermediate slots. Label-class size is restricted to slots <N, and crossChords counts target-slot/block pairs. Zero-cut formula uses natural truncated subtraction and both slack parameters equal zero. Block trajectory freezes at actual T. Full Conclusion has existence of a uniformly convergent subsequence and universality over every eligible convergent subsequence; Lipschitz constant 1, every extended-real theta, integrated level excess >=1, total range plus one <=k*c0, and existence of a path neither monotone nor antitone.
checks.outline: Each prose definition was checked against Defs, DefsM and NativeRunLimits.Conclusion/of_cut.
checks.program_role: Precisely identifies which geometric conditions are supplied by the wrapper and thus which standalone conditions cannot separate transpose from unrelated tasks.

checks.label: model-information-and-background-scope
checks.exact_statement: Helper entropy from attained range now explicitly assumes X is supported on F; arbitrary-law deficit is distinguished from uniform cardinal deficit. Sequence exclusions are identified as permitting size-dependent machines with separately charged resources and do not redefine T. Multiplication connection is labeled cited background rather than a newly Lean-proved theorem.
checks.outline: No extra proof claim is made for cited background.
checks.program_role: Separates finite coding obstructions, native sequence statements and the fixed-machine target.

findings.issue: Initial opening applied both the cut inequality and limiting conclusions to every payload computation, although the full limit contract is for uniformly linear-time payload families.
findings.resolution: Opening now distinguishes a cut-enforcing prefix through any payload computation from full limiting conclusions for uniformly linear-time payload families; theorem statement was already exact.

limitations: Source-level statement/outline review, not an independent replay of all analytic or compiler proofs.
Prior literature attribution is assessed against the cited manuscript/dependency description here, not a fresh exhaustive literature search.
